name: Elena Rodriguez
bio:
Elena Rodriguez discovered her passion for motorsport while assisting her father, a mechanic for a local rally team. She pursued mechanical engineering, graduating top of her class and quickly securing a role in a Formula 3 team. Her meticulous approach and innovative problem-solving skills led to a rapid ascent, culminating in her becoming a lead engineer within five years. 

As a technical director, Elena believes in empowering her team and fostering a collaborative environment. She focuses on long-term strategies and sees the big picture, constantly seeking marginal gains through advanced data analysis and simulation. Her loyalty to teams and dedication to innovation set her apart, resulting in multiple championship wins.

Elena is now looking for a new challenge, ready to apply her experience and visionary leadership to a team with ambitious goals.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a lean, athletic build, reflecting her active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Prefers to communicate technical concepts through visual diagrams.
Strives to use sustainable and eco-friendly practices, even within motorsport.
